objects.name: vehicle
objects.description: One vehicle, trailer or tracker the operator runs. Nothing here is installed anywhere; the same object serves a thing that moves.

indexes.name: depot
indexes.description: The home depot browse, which is a word this domain has and the utility next door does not.

indexes.name: plate
indexes.description: Finds a vehicle by registration, and stops the same plate being entered twice.

objects.name: coupling
objects.description: What is hitched to what, what is a component of what, and which tracker is watching which vehicle.

objects.name: channel
objects.description: One quantity the telematics units report — fuel level, odometer, coolant temperature — and its unit.

objects.name: sample
objects.description: One telematics sample from one vehicle at one moment.

objects.name: retention_rule
objects.description: How long samples of one kind are kept.

objects.name: driver
objects.description: One person who drives. The fleet's own object — this module has no rule that touches it, and declares no role it could fill.

fields.name: licence_number
fields.description: The driving licence this person holds. Unique across the fleet.

fields.name: licence_expires_at
fields.description: When the licence stops being valid.

indexes.name: expiry
indexes.description: Finds the licences about to lapse.
